item.name: Get historical candles data for an instrument

request.name: Get historical candles data for an instrument

description.content: Retrieves historical price data in OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume) format for a specified instrument. The data is organized into time-based candles of various intervals, from one minute to one week.

variable.description: (Required) Sorting direction of the candles data. Use 'asc' for oldest to newest, or 'desc' for newest to oldest.
(Required) Time interval for each candle. Determines the granularity of the price data. Shorter intervals provide more detailed price action but require more data points.
(Required) Number of candles to retrieve. Maximum value is 1000. For longer historical periods, consider using a larger time interval or making multiple requests.
(Required) Unique identifier of the financial instrument to retrieve candles for. This ID is consistent across all eToro systems.
